text:
ITEM 1 | Main piece: elongated, irregular cluster about 9 cm long and 5 cm wide, stacked in layers; golden-orange to tan surface with darker brown caramelized patches and speckles of red and green flecks, glossy and slightly oily sheen, moist-looking coating that clings to the surface, edges uneven and layered with visible fibrous, flaky texture, sitting on the right-center of the plate | 210
ITEM 2 | Grey-brown, dense piece about 4 cm by 2.5 cm tucked under the main cluster, matte surface with some darker browned edges and a pale cream-colored section at one end, firm with slight sheen | 45
ITEM 3 | Pale off-white, soft-looking piece about 4 cm by 3 cm on the right edge of the cluster, lightly browned at edges, slightly flaky with a dry matte surface and small crumbly bits | 40
ITEM 4 | Small scattered pale crumbs and bits, about 2 cm across, cream-white with a few tiny orange and green specks, lying at the lower-left base of the pile | 8
ITEM 5 | Orange-red sauce smear, thin and irregular, a few spots of about 1 cm, glossy and wet, visible on the plate rim near the food pile | 5
